The executor failed the 'net metric' (H36:L40) validation. 

Looking at the trace, the expected values for row 36 (e.g., H36: -4.07) differ significantly from the actual values written (e.g., H36: -7.00). 

Crucially, the 'got' value (-7.0) is the same across all regions (H36, H37, H38, H39, H40 all resulted in -7.0000000000000036 for column H). This suggests the executor used absolute row references (e.g., `$H$12` instead of `H12`) or failed to increment the row indices when filling the formulas for the 6 different regions in the calculation `(Successful - Failed) / Capacity * 100`. 

The 'got' value of -7.0 matches the calculation for the first region (row 12, 19, 26). The executor likely applied the row 12 formula to all rows 35-40.
